rounds.response:
Risks of running the partial fallback (~3 months): 1) Customer confusion and increased complaints when only some rooms are confirmed, harming NPS and retention; 2) Revenue impact from lost or reduced discounts and higher abandonment after partial confirmations; 3) Higher support and operations load for refunds, rebookings, and manual adjustments; 4) Partner/account friction from inconsistent pricing and confirmations that can damage integrations and renewals; 5) Data and billing reconciliation issues that complicate reporting and finance workflows.

Guardrails & mitigations for this quarter: 1) Standardize and surface clear in‑product messaging, help‑center content, and partner copy to reduce confusion; 2) Implement monitoring and weekly KPIs with alert thresholds for partial-rate spikes, discount failures, and high-value customer impact; 3) Deliver a CX support playbook, dedicate short-term staffing, and define an escalation path for prioritized cases; 4) Automate refunds for unconfirmed rooms and enable fast rebooking attempts with explicit customer choices; 5) Apply short-term product controls (e.g., restrict bundled discounts for partial-eligible flows or flag affected partners for manual review).
